claimBoundary: The experiment isolates reconstruction differences by first decoding one retained real progressive JPEG to an 8-bit RGB source through the pinned libjpeg-turbo installation, then re-encoding that exact RGB source with controlled grayscale/4:4:4/4:2:2/4:2:0 sampling. It is a mechanism experiment, not a new retained-photo corpus.

ImageCraft/ImageIO output must have matching geometry, tight RGBA8 and opaque alpha. RGB deltas against one-shot libjpeg-turbo are observations only: no post-hoc max-code, MAE or PSNR value becomes a conformance tolerance.

The useful causal contrast is sampling structure: grayscale has no chroma reconstruction, 4:4:4 has no chroma upsampling, 4:2:2 adds horizontal 2x chroma upsampling and 4:2:0 additionally adds vertical 2x chroma upsampling. A larger 4:2:0 residual therefore localizes pressure without asserting which backend is perceptually superior.
